questions.prompt: What did James and Anna decide to make?
questions.evidenceText: "Let us make a rocket!" said James. "We can fly all the way into space!"

questions.prompt: Why did James and Anna grin at their rocket?
questions.rationale: Calling it the best rocket and grinning shows that James and Anna were proud of the rocket they made.
questions.evidenceText: "It is the best rocket ever made!" said James. He and Anna stood back and grinned.

questions.prompt: Where were they when the trip ended?
questions.evidenceText: BUMP! They were back in the garden. Mum had made cake. "Best trip EVER!" they said.
